applicability.classification: task_specified; definitions engineering_choice pending statistical-validator review
applicability.scope: every diagnostic is computed from exactly the frames and component set of the s it diagnoses; no target-hop outcome, own-path frame or barrier label enters any diagnostic

rho_F.definition: sqrt(1 - Sxy^2 / (Sxx * Syy)) over the component-pooled Eq. 17 sums (= |sin theta| between stacked DFT and ML force vectors; rho_F^2 equals the Study-1 residual_fraction)
rho_F.undefined: Sxx <= 0 or Syy <= 0 -> undefined, recorded with its reason, never imputed
rho_F.denominator_note: the DFT-denominator variant equals tan(theta), monotone in rho_F, so rankings and AURC are identical
rho_F.uncertainty: whole-frame percentile bootstrap with the same draws as s
rho_F.sensitivity: frame-median of per-frame |sin theta_f|; reported with the informative-component count and mean |F_DFT| because DFT force noise inflates rho_F on low-force frames
rho_F.sign_rule: undefined when Sxy <= 0 (sin theta ignores the sign; anti-aligned forces are not uniform softening)
rho_F.sensitivity_informative_components: rho_F over components with |F_DFT| >= 0.1 eV/A only; requires informative-component sums recorded at inference (transfer runner); not computable from Study-1 sums
rho_F.interval_use: percentile CI is biased near 0 and is descriptive only
rho_F.canonical_storage: stored quantity is residual_fraction (= sin^2 theta, Study-1 sufficient statistics); rho_F = sqrt(residual_fraction) is a derived display value with identical rankings and AURC
rho_F.naming_note: rho_F denotes |sin theta| of the stacked force vectors, not a correlation and not rho_SRT; reports define it at first use (statistical-validator m2)

scale_uncertainty.definition: (q97.5 - q2.5) / (2 * s_hat) of the whole-frame bootstrap

li_host_disagreement.undefined: either component set fails the frozen support rule
li_host_disagreement.expected_definedness: often undefined on endpoint-relaxation frames (near-zero Li forces); n_undefined reported

energy_dependence.definition: |ln(s_high / s_low)| after a median split of the calibration frames on the parent configurational-energy reference dE_f (eV/atom); the median frame goes to the low half
energy_dependence.undefined: either half fails the frozen support rule
energy_dependence.minimum_frames: defined only when each half meets the frozen support rule (in practice >= 20 frames)
energy_dependence.test_material_energy_reference: for test-side materials R(m, N) is built from that material's leakage-eligible non-path frames only
energy_dependence.known_bias: the low-energy half is low-force, so DFT-noise attenuation biases s_low; reported as a limitation

combined.definition: equal-weight mean of within-population percentile ranks of the defined retrospective force diagnostics
combined.role: exploratory descriptive comparator in retrospective risk-coverage only; never part of any gate, predictor or endpoint

applicability.undefined_score_policy: a hop whose score is undefined is ordered after every defined score (abstained first) and counted

anion_family_handling.classifier: parent dominant-anion-count-v1: family element sets oxide{O}, sulfide{S}, halide{F,Cl,Br,I}, nitride{N}; atom counts from composition; strictly largest family wins; no family element -> other; tie between the two largest -> other
anion_family_handling.computable_from: composition only; never from outcomes or prospective results
anion_family_handling.unsupported_family_scale: family SRT unavailable for that unit (frozen support rule: >= 10 frames, >= 100 informative components, >= 3 materials); the hybrid predictor then returns the raw prediction labelled 'raw: family scale unavailable', counted separately from applicability abstention; never relabelled as family SRT
anion_family_handling.absent_family: a prospective family with no supported calibration-side scale is handled as unsupported_family_scale

selective_prediction.classification: task_specified; framing is the project owner's decision of 2026-11-01

framings.selective_primary: abstained hops receive no SRT prediction; risk is computed on retained hops
framings.correct_or_raw_secondary: abstained hops keep the raw B0 prediction; coverage = fraction of all hops corrected; risk over all hops; a hop without an SRT prediction (unsupported s) is never corrected, has an undefined score and is counted as uncorrectable, so the curve ends at n_correctable/n; no SRT error is imputed; labelled as distinct from the no-fallback scale rule

selective_prediction.aurc: (1/n) * sum_{k=1..n} risk(k), risk(k) = mean error of the first k hops; tied scores contribute their expected risk under uniformly random within-tie order
selective_prediction.random_baseline: analytic: expected risk(k) = full-coverage mean error, so AURC_random = full-coverage MAE; a Monte Carlo band is drawn for figures only
selective_prediction.oracle: ordering by the realised error; diagnostic upper bound only
selective_prediction.uncertainty: paired chemical-system cluster bootstrap with the parent frozen resample count and seed derivation
selective_prediction.association: Spearman between each score and correction benefit |raw error| - |SRT error|, with cluster-bootstrap CI
selective_prediction.undefined_scores: AURC is reported both with undefined scores ordered last and on the defined subset, with n_undefined

deployment_gate.classification: project owner's decision of 2026-11-01: label-free quantile threshold
deployment_gate.rule: apply SRT iff the frozen support rule holds and rho_F <= q_rho and scale_uncertainty <= q_ci

threshold_population.study_2a: regime-matched: for each Study-1 published-train target hop (primary population), s and its diagnostics recomputed from that material's non-path endpoint frames under the s_scope rule; supported hops only; force data only
threshold_population.study_4: per repeat, the force diagnostics (no barrier) of a frozen identity-only threshold slice of that repeat's training/calibration-side chemical systems (study4_threshold_slice); the slice units are never conformal-calibration or test units of that repeat, so threshold units and every unit on which the repeat's FDR, power, error or selection is evaluated are disjoint; the gate is applied identically to calibration and test units
threshold_population.study_5: development-set diagnostics (disjoint from conformal calibration units), Y-free

deployment_gate.s_scope: material scope with one frame rule for every unit: leakage-eligible non-path (endpoint-relaxation) frames of the target material; own path forbidden; this is the parent test-side rule applied identically to threshold, calibration and evaluation units
deployment_gate.gated_global_family: gated B1/B2 diagnostics describe one pooled s per scope, so the gate is a scope-level switch; reported as such, never as a per-hop gate
deployment_gate.reporting: realised coverage of the gate on every evaluated population; threshold accounting (n used, unsupported, undefined)
deployment_gate.threshold_access: Study 2a: published-train non-path endpoint frames via require_outcome_access(purpose='threshold_selection'); Study 4: per-repeat thresholds from the threshold slice's force diagnostics are part of the pre-specified analysis under seal 2 (not a tuning purpose; no barrier); Study 5: thresholds are computed from label-free representation or descriptor covariates and need no outcome access
deployment_gate.threshold_scale: thresholds are computed on the rho_F (= sqrt(residual_fraction)) scale; quantiles are not invariant under sqrt
deployment_gate.threshold_weighting_unit: one diagnostic value per material (not per hop), so materials with many hops are not over-weighted

study4_threshold_slice.rule: SHA-256(domain NUL parent_protocol_id NUL repeat_index NUL chemical_system)/2^256 < fraction (exact rational comparison), over the repeat's training/calibration-side systems only
study4_threshold_slice.fraction_source: the frozen holdout_fraction of the Study-5 weight-fit slice (density_ratio.settings.holdout_fraction), reused; not chosen from data
study4_threshold_slice.repeats_unchanged: the ten repeated partitions and the Study-4 hypotheses are unchanged; the conformal-calibration side of each repeat is its training/calibration side minus the threshold slice
study4_threshold_slice.decision: owner decision 2026-11-03: threshold-selection units must be disjoint from evaluated units
study4_threshold_slice.validity: exchangeability of calibration and test units is argued under the superpopulation model (systems i.i.d., the identity hash independent of the data); the slice is drawn from the training/calibration side only, so as an exact finite-population randomization statement over the fixed repeated partitions it does not cover test systems whose hash falls below the fraction; G4 is an empirical check either way
study4_threshold_slice.empty_slice: an empty slice or one without a supported value closes the gate (deployment_gate.undefined_thresholds)
study4_threshold_slice.fraction_check: the runner refuses a fraction different from density_ratio.settings.holdout_fraction

deployment_gate.study4_validation_units: published-validation systems are Study-4 units (published_validation_split_role); when one falls in a repeat's threshold slice it is used for that repeat's thresholds only (force diagnostics), never as a calibration or test unit of that repeat
deployment_gate.undefined_thresholds: owner decision 2026-11-03: a threshold population without any supported, defined value of a gated diagnostic (e.g. an empty Study-4 threshold slice, or a model with no supported training diagnostic in Study 2a) leaves the thresholds undefined and closes the gate: SRT is not applied and the raw prediction is kept, identically on every side; recorded with its accounting (e3sse.production.runners.frame_scales.thresholds_or_closed / gate_or_closed)
deployment_gate.seed_derivation: every runner seed uses a frozen e3sse.analysis.seed.v1 domain; per-material threshold bootstraps use ('cluster_bootstrap', 'deployment_gate_threshold', material_id) (common random numbers across models and stages), transfer material scales ('cluster_bootstrap', 'transfer_material_scale', hop_id), the representation tau_d bootstrap ('cluster_bootstrap', 'path_representation_tau_bootstrap', model) and the pilot MDE ('cluster_bootstrap', 'pilot_mde', model, repr(noise_eV))

endpoints.P4: per Group-A model m with s-bar <= 0.9: Delta-AURC_m = AURC(rho_F) - AURC_random for B3-gated material scope under selective_primary; one-sided bootstrap p_m = fraction of chemical-system cluster-bootstrap replicates with Delta-AURC* >= 0; reported as an approximate percentile-bootstrap p-value (CI inversion), not an exact test
endpoints.multiplicity: parent holm_family unchanged; P4_m is a key-secondary family with Holm across eligible models at one-sided alpha = 0.05; family-wise error is controlled within each family only, stated in every report
endpoints.P3: unchanged validity endpoint, not a superiority hypothesis

H6.hypothesis: pre-outcome force non-collinearity rho_F identifies hops where SRT is less accurate
H6.support: Holm-adjusted one-sided p_m < 0.05 for at least one eligible model
H6.refute: Delta-AURC_m >= 0 point estimate for every eligible model
H6.label_free_baseline: ranking by |raw barrier| (absolute errors grow with barrier size); rho_F must also be compared with it, descriptively
H6.inconclusive_zone: neither support nor refute: reported as inconclusive; any rho_F advantage beyond the |raw barrier| baseline is descriptive only

endpoints.primary_family: Holm across {P1_m : Group-A model m with s-bar <= 0.9} only (P2 removed from the active family with Study 3); P1_m p-value as in parent holm_family (one-sided chemical-system cluster-bootstrap p for rho_SRT <= 0)

pilot_inputs.p1_eligibility: s-bar from the published-train Study-1 force tables only; these may include path frames of published-train hops (permitted training data)
pilot_inputs.mde_scales: regime-matched endpoint-relaxation (non-path) frames of published-train primary hops, read with purpose threshold_selection
pilot_inputs.forbidden: no transfer, calibration, Study-4 or prospective target outcome; no frame outside the published-train split and no frame of a published test or validation nebDFT2k hop (checked by e3sse.production.runners.pilot.pilot_boundary); training frames of systems that also have held-out records are counted
pilot_inputs.role: design and power analysis fixed before any non-training outcome is unsealed; never used to tune results after outcomes are seen
pilot_inputs.access_record: every pilot read leaves an outcome_access record (units, SHA-256, purpose)
pilot_inputs.label_free_covariates: the MDE also reads the nebBVSE122k BVSE barriers of the published-test evaluation hops and their count (label-free covariates; no DFT or ML barrier)
pilot_inputs.check_timing: pilot_boundary runs on the declared frames before each read and is recorded after

label_budget_downstream.classification: paper_specified (Research Design 3.6 'propagated to barrier error', 4 RQ4)
label_budget_downstream.repeats_and_seeds: parent label_budget_stability (R, seed key without model_id, common random numbers across models)
label_budget_downstream.population: Study-2a evaluation hops whose material-scope eligible frames meet the parent label-budget population rule (N >= 60); frozen as a hop-set manifest before any barrier is read
outputs: SRT barrier absolute error with s_K per draw
fraction of draws with a defined s_K
label_budget_downstream.minimum_hops: 20 qualifying hops; below that the downstream curve is descriptive only
label_budget_downstream.nonpositive_s_K: a zero Eq. 17 denominator is an error (parent rule), recorded and reported; s_K <= 0 is reported as undefined for SRT, never imputed
label_budget_downstream.aggregation: per hop: mean over draws of the absolute SRT error, then mean over hops; medians also reported because 1/s_K is heavy-tailed at small K
label_budget_downstream.uncertainty_nesting: Monte Carlo draws nested inside the chemical-system cluster bootstrap
label_budget_downstream.stability_estimand: RQ4 stability keeps the parent finite-population-corrected SD of s_K; |s_K - s_full| is an additional descriptive output
label_budget_downstream.comparability_note: test-side K frames are endpoint (low-energy) frames; results are not comparable to Deng et al.'s single high-energy structure

representation.classification: task_specified; extraction details pending mlip-specialist verification
representation.unit: atom-level invariant node features of the migrating Li
representation.migrating_li: the Li atom with the largest minimum-image displacement between the first and last DFT-NEB image (geometry only)
representation.target_pooling: mean over interior images; sensitivity: the ML-highest-energy image
representation.calibration_population: the development reference population (amendments.prospective.support_gate.support_population_C); frame-level calibration features are not used for support
representation.normalization: per-model z-score fitted on the development population only (never on conformal-calibration features)
representation.support_metric: mean Euclidean distance to the k=5 nearest development-reference units in the z-scored original space (no further normalization); the same metric defines tau_d
representation.sensitivity_metric: Gaussian KDE log-density (Schultz et al., npj Comput. Mater. 2025)
representation.cross_model: never compare distances across architectures; per-model small multiples

projections.primary_2d: PCA fitted on training-side calibration features
projections.optional_2d: UMAP with fixed random_state, n_neighbors and min_dist recorded
projections.presentation_3d: PCA top three components, interactive HTML

representation.geometry_source: the frozen model's own converged ML-NEB relaxed band, identically for development, conformal-calibration and prospective units (owner decision 2026-11-01); migrating Li identified from the BVSE initial-path endpoints

path_representation.rule: one deterministic path-level vector per hop: per-image migrating-Li embeddings along the converged ML-NEB band, aggregated by a frozen operation; support measured in the original high-dimensional space
path_representation.candidate_form: z_path = [z_initial, z_saddle, z_final, mean_i z_i, std_i z_i] (saddle = ML-highest-energy image); optional compact host summary only if the model already supports it
path_representation.status: mapping rule and acceptance criteria pre-specified; per-model capture selection and acceptance results are server evidence
path_representation.mapping_rule: orientation: images ordered so the endpoint with lower ML energy comes first (ties: BVSE order kept); saddle: interior image with the highest ML energy (ties: lowest index after orientation); z_path = [z(initial), z(saddle), z(final), mean_interior z, std_interior z] of the migrating-Li row, interior = images strictly between the endpoints; for a structure-level-only representation the same blocks use the structure vector; z-scoring on the development population; a channel with zero development variance keeps sd = 1 and is reported
acceptance_criteria: every band image passes the probe checks (finite, invariant, permutation-consistent, deterministic) for the selected capture
the migrating-Li index is preserved from the BVSE path through ML-NEB (atom order unchanged)

label-free degeneracy check on the development population: coefficient of variation of leave-one-chemical-system-out k-NN distances >= 0.05, and tau_d bootstrap (1000 system resamples) coefficient of variation <= 0.10; otherwise the descriptor fallback applies

degeneracy_check.undefined: a non-finite CV (all LOCSO distances zero) fails the check

representation.failed_neb: no converged band -> no path representation -> no prediction; BVSE-path features are never substituted

embedding_capability_evidence.classification: server evidence: authoritative per-model embedding-capability reports, pinned by the project owner on 2026-11-02 before any outcome; no further capture search is performed
embedding_capability_evidence.verification: production preflight re-hashes every pinned file and checks that its canonical_name, its usability under representation.embedding_capability.merge_manifest and this pin agree; any mismatch blocks the freeze

M3GNet-MP-2021.2.8-PES.representation: model.graph_layers.2:output[1] (frozen rejected capture; not used for support)
M3GNet-MP-2021.2.8-PES.applicability_branch: descriptor_space (subject to open item descriptor_availability; otherwise reliability-gated prospective SRT unavailable for this model)

embedding_capability_evidence.not_pinned: the earlier CHGNet-0.3.0 report written with the broken probe fixture is superseded by the embedding_capability_completion report and is not evidence

selection.added_predictor: SRT_gated_correct_or_raw: material-scope s under deployment_gate.s_scope for every calibration and test unit; per-repeat Y-free thresholds set on the repeat's threshold slice (deployment_gate.study4_threshold_slice), disjoint from its calibration and test units; the gate is applied identically to calibration and test units; correct-or-raw framing
selection.unchanged: every parent study_4_contract and statistical_plan Study-4 rule (draws, seeds, alpha, c, MC SE, tie policy, one hop per chemical system, the ten repeated partitions) except the declared calibration-side change below
selection.declared_change_calibration_side: owner decision 2026-11-03 (declared deviation from the parent rule 'training-or-calibration side = calibration units'): in each repeat the threshold-slice systems (deployment_gate.study4_threshold_slice, about 20% of the training/calibration side) set the gate thresholds only and are removed from the calibration side for every predictor (raw, SRT_global, SRT_family, SRT_gated_correct_or_raw), so all predictors stay paired on identical units; H5a and H5b are evaluated on this smaller calibration side; test sides are unchanged

prospective.classification: project owner's decision of 2026-11-01; split assignment and s source pending statistical-validator review
prospective.deployment_predictor: E_deploy(x) = E_ML-NEB(x) / s_family if the candidate passes the representation-support gate, else E_ML-NEB(x) (raw); one predictor for the full population, applied identically to development, conformal-calibration and BVEL13k units
design: development set: choose and freeze the prospective model
conformal calibration set: identical ML-NEB pipeline, known DFT barriers
prospective.development_set: one unit per chemical system with published-test contact (published-test-only or spanning published splits) and nebDFT2k hops, TM/Hubbard-U systems included; unit hop by populations.calibration_side_unit_rule on non-validation materials. Study-5 revision 2026-11-03 (count-informed, outcome-free; statistical-validator and research-architect)
prospective.model_selection_rule: score the deployed predictor (ML-NEB under the frozen ML-NEB rule, representation-support gate, family SRT, correct-or-raw) on the development set; lowest MAE, ties by RMSE; requires ML-NEB on development hops; frozen before any conformal-calibration outcome is read; development outcomes read via a dedicated access purpose restricted to the hashed development manifest
prospective.calibration_set: one unit per published-train-only chemical system with nebDFT2k hops, TM/Hubbard-U systems included, unit hop by populations.calibration_side_unit_rule; never used to select the model, tune ML-NEB, build the support reference C/tau_d or the Gate-0 envelope. Study-5 revision 2026-11-03 (count-informed, outcome-free; statistical-validator and research-architect)
prospective.s_source: pooled s from MPLiTrj frames of training-side chemical systems without nebDFT2k hops (parent study4_predictor_calibration_independence pattern)
prospective.fixed_geometry_role: clean physics validation of SRT; not the deployment predictor
prospective.literature_check: only after the shortlist manifest is frozen and hashed
prospective.dependence_unit: one structure per chemical system and its rate-limiting hop h*_3: the first hop, in ascending (BVSE barrier, canonical hop key) order, whose addition makes the network 3-D percolating (minimax bottleneck, screening.rate_limiting_hop); covariate-only; identical for development, P and Q
prospective.guarantee_wording: approximate FDR control under stated assumptions (exchangeability after weighting, covariate-only selection, estimated density ratios, and hop-role invariance: the LiTraj-protocol DFT barrier of a hop given the frozen label-free covariates does not depend on whether the hop is its network's bottleneck); the target Y is the LiTraj-protocol barrier (non-spin-polarised PBE, no U) of the pool unit's rate-limiting hop h*_3 for every unit including TM/Hubbard-U systems; not a formal guarantee
prospective.known_limitation: nebDFT2k retains only converged NEBs, a possible selection on Y given X that weighting cannot correct
prospective.development_set_reuse: declared: Study 5 model selection reuses Study-2a published-test outcomes, consistent with Research Design 5.10 'best-validated model'
prospective.g1_contingency: if G1 fails, Research Design 6: selection proceeds with raw ML-NEB scores

support_gate.metric: d(x, C): mean Euclidean distance to the k=5 nearest neighbours in the original representation space (amendments.representation normalization); never on PCA/UMAP coordinates
support_gate.support_population_C: the development population: one unit hop per development system (populations.calibration_side_unit_rule, rate_limiting_exact or bottleneck_proxy), TM/Hubbard-U included
support_gate.threshold: tau_d = Q_q of leave-one-chemical-system-out k-NN distances over the development population (applicability_support.fit_reference), q = deployment_gate.quantile_level
support_gate.rationale: taking C and tau_d from the conformal calibration set would make the predictor depend asymmetrically on calibration covariates (statistical-validator and research-architect reviews); a disjoint development set keeps the predictor a fixed function of X
fallback_hierarchy: IF a stable frozen-model representation is verified in embedding_capability_manifest (documented_api or specialist-pinned module): latent-support metric
ELSE IF the label-free descriptor set is available for every development, calibration and pool unit: descriptor-space support metric
ELSE: reliability-gated prospective SRT is unavailable; ungated SRT-family is reported only as a labelled secondary baseline
support_gate.no_combination: sources are never mixed or weighted together

features: family one-hot (oxide, sulfide, halide, nitride, other; dominant-anion-count-v1)
descriptor_space.standardization: z-score fitted on the development population
descriptor_space.missing: a unit with any missing feature is unsupported (fail closed) and counted; never imputed
descriptor_space.status: proposed; the data-engineer must confirm every feature against the G0-audited schemas of nebDFT2k, nebBVSE122k and BVEL13k

support_gate.family_handling: descriptor space: family one-hot columns are NOT z-scored (fixed weight 1 per family difference); continuous features are z-scored on the development population
support_gate.availability: descriptor availability is decided per unit; a unit with any missing feature is unsupported

prospective.separate_quantities: representation support (SRT applicability), density-ratio weights w(X) for weighted conformal selection, and conformal p-values are three distinct quantities, never collapsed; w(X) is estimated without calibration or pool outcomes
prospective.retrospective_vs_prospective_reliability: force diagnostics (rho_F, CI(s), Li/host, energy) are retrospective reliability evidence and test whether representation support is informative; only the label-free support gate is part of the deployment predictor
prospective.freeze_order: development information -> freeze model and ML-NEB protocol -> ML-NEB conformal calibration -> BVEL13k; conformal-calibration outcomes never select the model or tune ML-NEB
prospective.s_scope: family (pooled, from MPLiTrj frames of training-side chemical systems without nebDFT2k hops)

proposed_frozen_rule.band: FIRE fmax=0.1 (declared deviation: LiTraj uses the ASE default 0.05 inside a 100-step budget), steps=100

bvse_recipe.source: historical nebDFT2k _init.xyz generation method reconstructed from the archive (docs/research/bvse_reproduction_reconstruction.md, 2026-11-04): ions >=0.3.5 code family (0.3.5, 0.4 and 0.4.1 compute identical paths), pymatgen BVAnalyzer oxidation states, SaddleFinder.bvse_neb with every default written out, SaddleFinder.run without endpoint relaxation. Supersedes the LiTraj c3ca5c2 notebooks/bvse_neb.ipynb demo recipe (perturbation kept, ions Decorator), refuted by the server reproduction audit (rate 0.0)

bvse_recipe.implied_neb: default=True builds ase NEB(climb=False, k=2.0, method='improvedtangent')
bvse_recipe.distortion: distort=True adds a seed-42 normal framework perturbation scaled to at most 0.2 A (zero on the mobile Li), identical for every image; SaddleFinder.run subtracts it before its final relaxation, so the paths handed to ML-NEB carry no perturbation (as in the archive); its applied maximum is recorded per unit
bvse_recipe.driver_note: SaddleFinder.run(neb, fmax=fire.fmax, steps=fire.steps, relax_endpoints=false): FIRE on the band, perturbation subtracted, FIRE on the band again (ions' documented procedure); endpoints are not relaxed because every archived endpoint Li sits on its lattice site
bvse_recipe.image_count_note: interpolate(n_images=7) when the unit's ions Edge.length (unwrapped source-target distance from the pristine structure) is >= long_hop_min_length_A, else n_images=5; applied identically to every side, pool included. Adopted under frozen_numeric_settings.image_count ('unless the reproduction audit shows nebDFT2k _init.xyz differs, which is then recorded'): audit evidence, not ions or LiTraj provenance (no source states it). Archive: 1253 paths with 5 images (Edge.length 2.049-4.494 A), 428 with 7 (4.502-5.989 A); 1681/1681 consistent; >= vs > at 4.5 A is not identifiable (no hop in 4.4941-4.5019 A); hops beyond 5.989 A are extrapolated with 7. Keeping n_images=5 would exclude every calibration hop >= 4.5 A while pool hops of any length remain, leaving the hop_length_A density-ratio feature without calibration support (statistical-validator review 2026-11-04)
bvse_recipe.convergence: recorded per unit (BVSE fmax <= fire.fmax); not an exclusion rule
bvse_recipe.pool_barrier_check: every unit's regenerated BVSE barrier is compared with the nebBVSE122k barrier of the same edge (label-free) and recorded; with pool_barrier_tolerance_eV null nothing is excluded; a tolerance is frozen only from the server reproduction audit (open item bvse_reproduction), never from outcomes
bvse_recipe.pool_barrier_tolerance_rule: owner decision 2026-11-03: null until the server BVSE reproduction evidence exists; while null every pool difference is recorded and no unit is excluded; a tolerance is frozen only from predetermined server evidence pinned as pool_barrier_tolerance_evidence {source in (bvse_reproduction_server_audit, numerical_repeatability_report), path, sha256, git_commit}; never this stage's own bvse_reproduction_report.json (its pool-difference distribution includes calibration units) and never a value selected from the distribution of nebBVSE122k pool differences (preflight check bvse_pool_tolerance)

density_ratio.features: the label-free descriptor set of the descriptor fallback plus E*_3 (critical BVSE barrier of the unit's structure) and the TM/Hubbard-U indicator (composition only); a separate quantity from the support score. The unit-hop bottleneck gap (em_bvse - E*_3) and the rate_limiting_exact indicator are never features (every pool unit has gap 0, which would zero every proxy calibration weight). Implementation: e3sse.production.runners.density.density_features
density_ratio.model: probabilistic classifier, pool vs calibration-population covariates; weights w = P(pool|x)/P(cal|x) times the class-size ratio
density_ratio.diagnostic: classifier AUC reported; near 0.5 supports unweighted selection as a sensitivity
density_ratio.p_side: a frozen random held-out slice of calibration-eligible chemical systems, processed by the identical pipeline (replaces development covariates, which follow a different distribution); held-out units are neither calibration nor selection units
density_ratio.fit_population: converged units only on both sides, after the frozen draw -> run -> drop order
density_ratio.assumption: dQ/dP(X, Y) depends on X only through the frozen descriptors; stated with every Study-5 result
density_ratio.frozen_elements: classifier, features, l2, convergence settings and clipping policy are frozen before fitting
density_ratio.population: weight-fit slice membership is fixed before any per-model ML-NEB or outcome: it is decided on the Gate-1 structural units (development excluded) from the chemical-system identifier alone, never from barriers, predictions, errors, applicability scores, ML-NEB convergence or any downstream result; w_hat is then fitted on the slice units converged under the selected model (owner decision 2026-11-02)
density_ratio.estimator: L2-regularized logistic domain classifier fitted by IRLS (plain numpy, deterministic, no random initialization); unpenalized intercept; features standardized on the fitting sample; frozen l2; non-convergence means no weights (fail closed)
diagnostics: out-of-sample domain AUC (calibration vs pool covariates, no outcomes) and in-sample AUC
fraction of unselectable test units (w_j/(sum w + w_j) > q)
density_ratio.clipping: off in the primary method; clipped weights only as a labelled sensitivity analysis, which changes the theoretical interpretation
density_ratio.independence_mapping: Theorem 3.5 requires w_hat measurable with respect to data independent of {(X_i,Y_i)} calibration and {(X_{n+j},c_{n+j})} test units: w_hat is fitted on a frozen SHA-ranked held-out slice of P-eligible chemical systems (never calibration units) and a frozen held-out slice of Q-eligible systems (never selected); both slices are disjoint by chemical system from every calibration and test unit; labels are not used; pending statistical-validator confirmation

settings.holdout_rule: a P-side or Q-side Gate-1 system is in the weight-fit slice iff int(SHA256('e3sse.weight-holdout' NUL parent_protocol_id NUL chemical_system), 16) / 2^256 < holdout_fraction (0.2); the parent protocol ID is used because this protocol's own ID depends on this rule. P-slice systems are never conformal-calibration units; Q-slice systems are never in the selectable prospective population

density_ratio.claim: estimated weights give approximate control only (Theorem 3.5); gamma is unobservable and may be unbounded under a misspecified logistic model, so no numerical bound is claimed; the FDR statement covers the non-held-out pool only

weighted_conformal.procedure: Weighted Conformalized Selection: published Biometrika 113(1) asaf066 main text canonical; equations read from arXiv:2307.09291v2 (sections 2-3, appendices A-C incl. C.1 proof of Theorem 3.1 and C.4 proof of Theorem 3.5)

equation_mapping.main_p_value: eq. 5 (strict <, plus w_j); eq. 4 is the randomized marginal p-value and is NOT the WCS p-value
equation_mapping.auxiliary_p_values: published Biometrika eq. 6: added term w(X_{n+j}) 1{Vhat_{n+j} < Vhat_l} for the focal unit j
equation_mapping.orientation: low barrier: Y' = -Y, c' = -c, clipped monotone score

tie_rules.primary: tie_free_lexicographic: per-unit tie keys = first 8 bytes of SHA256('e3sse.wcs-tie-key', protocol_id, analysis_id, unit_id); lexicographic (score, key); keys fixed before any score is computed, never redrawn
tie_rules.primary_theory_status: statistical-validator 2026-11-01: Theorem 3.1 applies to the augmented problem with the key as an independent i.i.d. covariate; FDR <= q holds marginally over the key draw, not conditionally on the realised keys
tie_rules.sensitivity: e3sse_conservative_le: equals official ConfSelect weighted_CS with U_j = 1 except that code's eq. 6 weight index; validity by the reviewer's one-line extension of the C.1 argument (not a published theorem); never primary

conformance_evidence.independent_reference: tests/wcs_published_reference.py (paper notation); 480 randomized fixtures across continuous, binary, 3-valued, heavy-tie, all-equal, single-null, zero- and all-selection scenarios; exact match under both tie rules
conformance_evidence.official_implementation: ying531/conformal-selection @ feffee179a1c76c10648bc950db024c356c020fd, confselect-python/ConfSelect/confselect.py weighted_CS(rand='dtm') with U fixed to 1: 200/200 tie fixtures equal to the sensitivity rule; 195/200 continuous fixtures equal; all 5 differences come from the official code using test_weights[k] (w_l) instead of w(X_{n+j}) in eq. 6; with that one index changed, 200/200 agree
conformance_evidence.official_eq6_discrepancy: production follows eq. 6 / eq. 33 (w_j); to be confirmed against the published eq. 6

estimated_weight_claim.known_weights: Theorem 3.1: finite-sample FDR <= q under i.i.d. P-calibration, i.i.d. Q-test, covariate shift dQ/dP = w(x), mutual independence of {Z_1..Z_n, Z_{n+j}} and the other test tuples
estimated_weight_claim.estimated_weights: Theorem 3.5: if w_hat is fitted on data independent of all calibration and test units, FDR <= q E[gamma^2 / (1 + q (gamma^2 - 1) / m)], gamma = sup_x max(w_hat/w, w/w_hat); not exact; inflation vanishes only as w_hat becomes consistent
estimated_weight_claim.reporting: E3-SSE claims at most the Theorem 3.5 bound for estimated weights, stated with the weight diagnostics; never exact finite-sample control

simulation_validation.interpretation: weighting is necessary for validity under predictor bias in the shifted region; with poor overlap it is valid but powerless (diagnosed by ESS/overlap); no claim that unweighted selection is generally safe

weighted_conformal.official_eq6_discrepancy: published-paper / reference-code discrepancy: official ConfSelect code (feffee17) uses w_l; E3-SSE follows the published eq. 6 (regression test test_published_eq6_focal_weight_is_w_j_not_the_reference_code_w_l)
